## Install

Requires a Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 26 or later.

1. Download the **.dmg** file below, open it and drag **Scripta** into **Applications**.
2. Open Scripta from your Applications folder. macOS says it can't verify the app. Click **Done**.
3. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway** next to "Scripta was blocked". Confirm with your password or Touch ID.

You only need step 3 once per version: Scripta isn't notarized by Apple. See the [README](https://github.com/saibot-strg/scripta#readme) for details and how to use Scripta.
